claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Gabazine is a selective GABA-A receptor antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and non-selective, possibly reflecting GABAergic signaling modulation in a subset of lines rather than a general cytotoxic mechanism.

routes.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist
